card.name: Author initials in reference lists
card.fires_on: A single capital letter for an author's initial, right after the surname in a citation's author list. Seen in reference sections of medical papers, before a comma or hyphen.

modes.label: Initial after surname
modes.description: A one-letter initial follows an author's surname in a comma-separated citation list.
modes.example: Zwart SR, Pierson D, Mehta<< S>>, Gonda S, and Smith SM

modes.label: Initial in book or editor lists
modes.description: An editor's or author's initial follows the surname in a book citation.
modes.example: Speroff L, Fitz<< M>>, eds. Clinical Gynecologic End

card.plain: It fires on the lone initial after an author's last name in a list of journal references.
